split.name: chronological-2025-first-three-races
split.cutoff_definition: After the leader completes cutoff_lap; cutoff 0 is pre-race. The target for each driver is that driver's next-to-complete lap, lap_number = laps_done_at_cutoff + 1.
target_mask: Target lap is not visible as completed in the cutoff snapshot.
Target lap is completed in the race and passes the same clean-lap classifier used by the linear pace model.
Predictors use only cutoff-known current compound and tire age + 1, and the driver's next lap number.
Target compound matches the cutoff-known compound; when the cutoff snapshot has a visible current stint, target stint matches that stint.
Both model means and target lap time are finite. Only identical paired targets contribute to either MAE.

training.bayesian: Earlier completed races from AsOfAccessor.history plus the current RaceSnapshot's completed clean laps; exclude History.results and all 2026 rows.
training.linear_baseline: fit_linear_pace on the current cutoff RaceSnapshot using the same clean-lap classifier.

metric.name: paired_next_lap_mean_absolute_error_seconds
metric.pac_06_gate: At least 15% lower Bayesian MAE and at least 500 paired targets. Otherwise PAC-06 is not met; do not alter this split or rerun the score.

era_limit: The 2023-2025 training and 2025 target races are all in ground_effect_2022_2025; this real evaluation cannot identify between-era effects.
